name: OptiFuse
old_description: Fuses and thermal circuit breakers (automotive, marine, line-voltage), UL-recognized
about:
OptiFuse is based in El Cajon, California, and was founded in 2000. The company began with the belief that lasting B2B partnerships depend on building relationships with the people involved, and it set out to make the world a safer place through circuit protection devices.

The company designs, manufactures, and markets overcurrent and circuit protection products. Its line includes fuses (blade, Class CC, Class J, Class T, Class RK5), circuit breakers (automotive, marine-grade, line-voltage), fuse holders, blocks, and accessories. OptiFuse operates as a stocking manufacturer with more than 500 authorized distributor locations across the U.S. and has expanded into international markets and e-commerce partnerships. A retail-packaged product line serves aftermarket customers.

OptiFuse sells exclusively through authorized distributors, serving automotive, marine, electronics, industrial, and commercial fleet sectors. Its products are used in applications ranging from vehicle emergency kits (FMCSR compliance) to marine engine compartments (IP67/IP66, ignition-protected) and industrial DIN-rail installations.

The company emphasizes a distributor-first model with no minimum orders, no minimum inventory requirements, and no POS reporting. Its stated mission is to shift power back to the customer by offering highly customizable parts and an educated, motivated distribution network.

name: Oregon Screen Impressions
about:
Oregon Screen Impressions has operated in Portland, Oregon since 1984. Founded as a small screen-printing shop, the company has grown over four decades into a full-service branding partner while remaining locally owned and operated. The founders are not named in public materials.

The company provides in-house screen printing and embroidery on apparel ranging from t-shirts and activewear to outerwear, caps, and beanies. Its finishing department handles hang tags, folding, rolling, bagging, labeling, and sorting. Beyond decoration, OSI runs fulfillment operations that include kitting, shipping, automatic reordering, and blind shipping, and it builds custom Shopify web stores and presale storefronts for events, tournaments, and schools. Creative services and product photography round out the offering.

Clients span small businesses, global brands, nonprofits, sports teams, and educational institutions across the United States. The company serves customers in Portland and nationally, shipping decorated merchandise and promotional goods such as stickers, drinkware, and coasters.

OSI emphasizes a “very capable, always human” approach, citing craftsmanship, exceptional customer service, and unrivaled versatility as its foundation. Its stated values include striving for balance, questioning norms, communicating with clarity, driving creativity, and trusting in collaboration. Sustainability efforts include a solar-panel installation at its Portland facility.

name: Oregon Solar and Battery
old_description: At Oregon Solar & Battery, we want going solar to be simple, clear, and stress free.
about:
Oregon Solar & Battery was founded in 2019 in Rogue River, Oregon, by Jake and Megan, who serve as co-owners. The company began after Jake observed homeowners being pressured into solar systems they didn’t fully understand, and Megan joined to bring transparent, education‑first guidance to the process.

The firm designs and installs complete home energy systems across Southern and Central Oregon, including residential solar arrays, battery backup, EV charging stations, off‑grid solar, and Generac generator installations. It manages every step from custom design and energy‑offset reporting through permitting, incentive paperwork, utility coordination, and final commissioning. To date the team has completed hundreds of installations.

Its customers are primarily homeowners and small businesses in Southern Oregon seeking to reduce utility costs and gain energy independence. The company works with utilities such as Pacific Power and incentive programs including Energy Trust of Oregon and the Oregon Department of Energy.

Oregon Solar & Battery differentiates itself through local expertise, a no‑pressure consultation model, and a commitment to transparency and community hiring. As an authorized Generac dealer and Energy Trust of Oregon Trade Ally, it emphasizes quality equipment, clear communication, and long‑term customer relationships.

about:
Oreion Motors operates from Corrales, New Mexico, where it designs and manufactures a line of off-road vehicles. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no individual founders are named in available sources.

The product portfolio includes utility task vehicles such as the Rover 800cc, Trailwarden 1000, Reeper 4x4, Reeper Sport, and Reeper Apex 1100cc, along with 2–4 and 4–6 passenger golf carts and the Beach Buggy. Beyond its own models, Oreion provides vehicle engineering and development, contract manufacturing and OEM services, plastic component molding, composite parts and molds, and paint and finishing. The company also manages a global distribution network.

Oreion serves the powersports, automotive, defense, and government specialty vehicle markets. Its customers include riders, dealers, and partners worldwide, with distribution reaching the United Arab Emirates, Germany, Spain, France, Canada, Mexico, Colombia, and other South American countries.

about:
Origin Factory Store, operating under the ORIGIN® brand, is headquartered in Farmington, Maine. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in the available sources. The business presents itself as an American-made apparel, footwear, and gear brand with a focus on domestic manufacturing.

ORIGIN produces a range of soft goods and footwear including performance denim, stretch canvas work pants, sneakers, fleece hoodies, performance polos, waffle-knit layers, and training apparel. Key product lines feature proprietary fabrics such as MOAB™ stretch canvas, NanoRip stretch-woven ripstop, and CORE Waffle knit (69% polyester/31% cotton). The company states that its joggers are manufactured in North Carolina and that its sneakers are assembled from a 100% U.S. supply chain—including Vibram® outsoles and MOAB™ uppers—by skilled American craftsmen. Manufacturing processes encompass cut-and-sew assembly, knitwear production, ripstop weaving, felled-seam construction, gusseted patterning, double-needle topstitching, and military-spec hardware installation.

The brand serves consumer markets directly through its e-commerce channel, targeting outdoor, tactical, training, and Brazilian jiu-jitsu (BJJ) enthusiasts. No business-to-business customers or industrial end markets are identified in the source material.

ORIGIN positions its domestic supply chain as a differentiator, framing the re-establishment of American sneaker and apparel manufacturing as a new standard for quality and durability. The company emphasizes overbuilt construction, odor-control technologies such as HeiQ Fresh, and durable water-repellent finishes to extend product life across work, training, and daily wear.

about:
Otto Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in 2002 in Lincoln, Nebraska, as a family-owned and operated business. The company’s grassroots story began with the founders identifying a need for custom electronic assemblies and committing long hours to fulfill expedited orders and growing volumes, building a reputation for reliability through hands-on effort.

The company manufactures custom electronics, cable assemblies, and wire harnesses built to customer specifications. Its capabilities include component sourcing, assembly, firmware loading, and testing and calibration. Specific assembly types produced range from Ethernet and JST connectors to Deutsch, Delphi Weather Pack, Molex, and circular Euro connectors, as well as single-wire processing and ribbon cable assemblies.

Otto Manufacturing serves businesses across multiple industries, notably agriculture and industrial sectors. The company works with clients requiring custom electronic products, cable assemblies, and wire harnesses for diverse applications, leveraging its staff’s years of industry experience to meet evolving demands.

The company emphasizes its commitment to quality control and clear communication throughout the project lifecycle, rooted in a family-run philosophy that prioritizes hard work and responsiveness to shifting customer demands. This approach is intended to deliver the lowest cost and highest quality for each custom order.

name: Ozark Solar
old_description: Providing solar solutions to northwest Arkansas & the surrounding areas.
about:
Ozark Solar is based in Bella Vista, Arkansas. Founded in 2007 by Josh Whittle, who serves as owner, the company began with a focus on bringing energy independence to a four-state region covering Arkansas, Oklahoma, Missouri, and Kansas.

The firm provides solar installation and roofing services. Its offerings include grid-tied solar systems, hybrid off-grid/grid-tied systems, commercial solar installations, residential roofing repair and replacement, off-grid solar systems using Fortress Power equipment, whole-home Generac generator installations, and solar panel detachment and reset services. The company reports that its installations have generated over 1.7 gigawatts of solar energy to date.

Ozark Solar serves residential and commercial customers across its service area. Residential clients include homeowners seeking grid-tied or off-grid power, as well as remote cabins, farms, and homesteads. Commercial clients range from small businesses to larger facilities requiring roofing and solar solutions.

The company emphasizes integrity and transparency, stating it is fully bonded and offers financing options with $0 down for qualified applicants. It also assists customers in claiming the 30% federal investment tax credit. A noted operational differentiator is a 7- to 14-day turnaround for solar panel detachment and reset work.

name: P D & E Electronics LLC
about:
PD&E Electronics operates from North Hampton, New Hampshire, where it was founded in 1967 as a semiconductor company serving a dozen local customers in the Boston area. The business began by building custom assemblies for semiconductor manufacturers and expanded through the acquisition of three product lines: ITT Selenium Division, Curtis-Wright Thermal Relays, and the North Hills RF Coil Line.

Today the company functions as a full-service custom electronics provider with design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities. Its product portfolio spans discrete rectifiers, rectifier modules, high-voltage and high-power rectifiers, printed circuit board assemblies (single- or multi-layer, through-hole or surface-mount), voltage regulators, power supplies (AC-DC, DC-AC, DC-DC converters and custom designs), and a range of custom assemblies including circuit cards, panels, filters, encapsulated servo amplifiers and indicator display lights. The firm also produces relays, flashers and sensors such as solid-state time delays, voltage monitors and ground-fault detectors. It reports manufacturing tens of thousands of distinct component types.

Customers include semiconductor companies, industrial OEMs and U.S. defense agencies. PD&E has acted as a second source for devices originally supplied by brands such as HV Component Associates, ITT Semiconductor, Microsemi/Unitrode, Semtech, Sensitron and others, offering improved delivery and pricing while meeting or exceeding original specifications.

The company emphasizes quality through in-process inspection, screening and final testing, citing an average quality rating of approximately 98 percent over two decades. It differentiates itself with engineering oversight of hand-built assemblies, custom design assistance from concept to completion, and a support staff that includes engineers, quality managers and production specialists.
